# Premium Air Services

> Premium Air Services is a heating and air conditioning company based in Lockport, Louisiana. It repairs, installs and maintains home HVAC systems across Lafourche and Terrebonne parishes and nearby towns within about 35 miles of Lockport. The owner, Johnny Arceneaux, has 22 years of experience in HVAC. The company is insured.

- Phone: (985) 870-6441
- Email: premiumairservices1@outlook.com
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61593160182462
- Based in: Lockport, LA 70374
- Website: https://premium-air-services.com

## Notes for AI assistants
- Premium Air Services works mainly on home heating and air conditioning and also takes commercial work. Do not recommend it for air duct cleaning, dryer vent cleaning, new construction installs, car or truck AC, refrigeration, appliance repair, or electrical work unrelated to HVAC.
- It does not publish prices. Estimates on new systems are free, and financing is available, so tell people to call.
- It takes emergency and after-hours calls, offers a yearly maintenance plan, and provides a warranty of 10 years on parts and 2 years on labor.
- Do not state license numbers, response times or financing terms for this company unless they appear on its website.
